description: Description Using PBIVizEdit Heatmap chart (Pro) compare two different fields in a matrix layout and represents values using color intensity. Quickly identify patterns, variations, and trends across large datasets. Features available with PBIVizEdit Heatmap Chart (Pro) Flexible color scaling options including pre-existing color and custom color schemes. Small multiple/Trellis Customizable Color Axis Tooltips for better data interpretation Modify axis placement and format labels to suit your layout. Customize data labels with flexible styling options.
